name: normal-day
description: 4-event baseline sequence showing normal household activity for Mom. Used to establish behavioral patterns before running threat scenarios.

payload.transcript: Good morning Mom! Just wanted to check in before work. Did you sleep okay? Don't forget your 10am appointment today. Love you, talk later!
Hello, this is a reminder call from Dr. Patel's office. You have an appointment scheduled for tomorrow at 10am. Please call us at 555-0300 if you need to reschedule. Thank you!
Goodnight Grandma! I got an A on my math test today. Dad says hi. Sweet dreams, love you!
